title: Our Credentials | Insured & Warrantied | Proud Paintbrush
metaDescription: The Proud Paintbrush is fully insured ($1M liability), backs work with a 2 & 5-Year Written Warranty, partners with Sherwin-Williams, and is locally owned since 2020.
bodyHtml:
Why Homeowners Trust The Proud Paintbrush

Choosing a painter is really about trust — you're handing someone the keys to the place you care about most. Here is exactly what stands behind our work, in plain language.

Fully Insured · $1M Liability

The Proud Paintbrush carries general liability insurance with a $1,000,000 limit. That protects your home and your peace of mind if the unexpected ever happens on a job. A certificate of insurance is available on request — just ask.

A note on licensing: Texas does not issue or require a state license for residential painting contractors. Any painter claiming to be "licensed" for house painting in Texas is misrepresenting how it works here. What actually protects you is real insurance and a written warranty — both of which we carry.

2 & 5-Year Written Warranty

Our workmanship is backed in writing — not a verbal promise.

  • 2-Year Written Warranty (standard): covers our workmanship — peeling, blistering, or flaking caused by application — on every qualifying project.

  • 5-Year Written Warranty (upgrade): available on qualifying projects paired with premium coatings, extending workmanship coverage and touch-up support for longer.

Normal wear, water intrusion, structural movement, and physical damage are not covered — we explain exactly what each warranty includes before you ever book. See full warranty details →

Sherwin-Williams Professional Partnership

We're a professional Sherwin-Williams partner and specify their coatings on the vast majority of our projects. That partnership means the right product for each surface and our Gulf Coast climate, consistent color, and finishes engineered to last in Texas heat and humidity.

Background-Checked Crews

The people who show up at your home are vetted, professional, and respectful of your space. We background-check our crews because you should never have to wonder who is in your home.

Locally Owned Since 2020

The Proud Paintbrush is locally owned and operated, serving Sugar Land and Fort Bend County since 2020. The person who estimates your job is the person who stands behind it — not a national franchise running a template. We live and work here, and our reputation is built one neighbor at a time.

Ready to Work With a Team You Can Trust?

Get a free, no-pressure on-site estimate from a fully insured, locally owned painting team.

Schedule Your Free Estimate
